task: Hotfix unknown verdict fail-closed quality gate

events.content: Investigated the quality-gate downgrade path: it treated any final verdict in ATTENTION_VERDICTS (FAIL_VERDICTS | UNKNOWN | DID_NOT_RUN) as downgradeable to WARN whenever no non-infra CODE_QUALITY failure existed, without checking whether each individual infra-flagged verdict was actually an explicit infra-failure token.

Added is_blocking_unknown_verdict() and should_downgrade_infra_only_failures() to .github/scripts/aggregate_quality_verdicts.py, and replaced the blanket ATTENTION_VERDICTS downgrade check in main() with a per-agent verification that every failing verdict is an explicit member of DOWNGRADEABLE_INFRA_VERDICTS (FAIL_VERDICTS | DID_NOT_RUN) before allowing the WARN downgrade.

Added regression tests test_unknown_infra_failure_stays_blocking and test_unrecognized_verdict_token_stays_blocking to tests/test_aggregate_quality_verdicts.py, pinning that DID_NOT_RUN plus a literal UNKNOWN (or plus an unrecognized token like FOOBAR) on infra-flagged axes still resolves to final_verdict UNKNOWN rather than WARN.
